summary: Configured a 512 MiB LUKS2-encrypted ext4 volume on node1, mounted read/write at /srv/secure. It now unlocks and mounts automatically during boot, with data persistence verified after a clean restart.
actions_performed: Generated and protected an on-node key file.
Created the LUKS2 container and ext4 filesystem.
Corrected an initial read-only boot-order issue.
Restarted node1 and verified automatic unlock, read/write mounting, preserved data, and new writes.

evidence.summary: Proves the LUKS2 container, protected key and backing file, dmcrypt configuration, service dependencies, boot enablement, and fstab entry.
Shows the active LUKS2 mapping, ext4 read/write mount, writable block devices, preserved data, and successful write test.
Documents the initial healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, detected read-only recovery issue, and verified remediation.

Proves the final healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 0a186f3e-b1da-4146-91bb-2c602029665f to b30015f7-57b3-4af4-bb4d-228880447890, and complete read/write recovery with persisted data.
